Age Calculator

Pick your date of birth to see your age in years, months and days. You can also work out your age on a specific date, such as a job or admission deadline.

🔮 Horoscope & fortune🎂 Age calculator💬 WhatsApp direct📿 Tasbeeh counter📏 Unit converter & plot area🔳 QR code generator

Results follow the Gregorian calendar. For official forms, check the age rule and the cut-off date in the notice.

How to calculate your age

  1. Choose your date of birth.
  2. If you need your age on a particular date (for example an application deadline), change the second box; otherwise leave today's date.
  3. Press “Calculate age”.
  4. You will see years, months, days, total days, weeks, hours and the days left until your next birthday.

Age calculator FAQ

How do I find my age on a job application cut-off date?

Enter your date of birth, then choose the cut-off date from the notice in the second box. The tool gives your age on that date.

Are leap years included?

Yes. Days are counted on the real calendar, so leap years are included automatically.

How is age in Hijri years worked out?

The tool divides your total days by the average lunar year (about 354.37 days) for an approximate figure. It is an estimate, not an exact Hijri birth date.

Is my date of birth saved?

No. It is used inside your browser only.
